title.rendered: Recording of Board Work Session – February 3, 2021

content.rendered: Due to technical difficulties, we were unable to live stream this evening’s Board Work Session on our YouTube channel. We apologize for any inconvenience caused by these technical challenges. The recording is now available at: https://youtu.be/Yssm_-23f_k
